root.label: Chino Hills kidnapping and fatal shooting

events.label: Chino Hills kidnapping and fatal shooting

slots.name: event date
slots.sentence: The abduction and police chase took place in Chino Hills, Calif., last Wednesday.

slots.name: start time
slots.sentence: The incident began around 10:14 p.m. last Wednesday after the authorities were dispatched to reports of gun shots and a man screaming at the victim’s home.

slots.name: suspect age
slots.sentence: According to the authorities, Mr. Bo, 66, and his brother, Zhengfeng Bo, 67, led sheriff’s deputies on a brief car chase last Wednesday after kidnapping Mr. Aikebaer, 60, from his home in Chino Hills, an upper-middle-class community roughly 35 miles east of downtown Los Angeles.
